title: Record the lost-free cover bound
body:
## Summary
- One hundred twelve orthonormal frames cover the 112 selected ports with total weight 14, so a lost-free set has size at most 56. The retained 32-plane witness meets the lost-free pair condition.
- With fixed block cost 72, size 32 costs 232, size 37 costs 222, and size 56 costs 184. The cost drops below `1792/9` at size 49. The selected kappa is unchanged.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The 4,032-frame census is not rerun.
